{{Short description|none}}
This is a glossary of properties and concepts in [[symplectic geometry]] in mathematics. The terms listed here cover the occurrences of symplectic geometry both in [[topology]] as well as in [[algebraic geometry]] (over the [[complex number]]s for definiteness). The glossary also includes notions from [[Hamiltonian geometry]], [[Poisson geometry]] and [[geometric quantization]].

In addition, this glossary also includes some concepts (e.g., virtual fundamental class) in [[intersection theory]] that appear in symplectic geometry as they do not naturally fit into other lists such as the [[glossary of algebraic geometry]].

== P ==

{{term|Poisson}}
{{defn|no=1|1=[[Poisson algebra]].}}

== S ==

{{glossary}}
{{term|shifted symplectic structure}}
{{defn|A generalization of [[symplectic structure]], defined on derived Artin stacks and characterized by an integer degree; the concept of symplectic structure on smooth algebraic varieties is recovered when the degree is zero.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Shifted Symplectic Structures|last1=Pantev|first1=T.|last2=Toen|first2=B.|last3=Vaquie|first3=M.|last4=Vezzosi|first4=G.|arxiv=1111.3209|journal=Publications mathématiques de l'IHÉS|volume=117|year=2013|pages=271&ndash;328|doi=10.1007/s10240-013-0054-1|s2cid=11246087}}</ref>}}

{{term|Spectral invariant}}
{{defn|[[Spectral invariants]].}}

{{term|Springer resolution}}

{{term|symplectic action}}
{{defn|A [[Lie group action]] (or an action of an [[algebraic group]]) that preserves the symplectic form that is present.}}

{{term|symplectic reduction}}

{{term|symplectic variety}}
{{defn|An algebraic variety with a symplectic form on the smooth locus.<ref>[https://mathoverflow.net/q/49111 Is the generic deformation of a symplectic variety affine?]</ref> The basic example is the [[cotangent bundle]] of a [[smooth algebraic variety]].}}

{{term|symplectomorphism}}
{{defn|A [[symplectomorphism]] is a diffeomorphism preserving the symplectic forms.}}

{{glossary end}}

== V ==

{{glossary}}
{{term|[[virtual fundamental class]]}}
